config.hubs.name: Hubs
config.hubs.description: Voice channels that create a temporary voice channel for whoever joins them. In the name, {user} is replaced by the member's display name. A limit of 0 means no limit.
config.hubs.fields.name: Channel name
hub.saved: {{channel}} now creates a temporary voice channel for whoever joins it.
hub.removed: {{channel}} no longer creates temporary voice channels. The channels already created are kept until they are empty.
hub.unknownChannel: This voice channel no longer exists.
hub.isTemporary: A temporary voice channel cannot be a hub.
hub.invalidName: The channel name must be 1 to 100 characters long.
hub.invalidLimit: The user limit must be a whole number from 0 to 99.
hub.missingPermissions: The bot cannot create channels next to {{channel}}: it lacks {{permissions}}.
hub.cooldown: you just created a channel: try again {{time}}.
hub.unavailable: the bot lacks the permissions to create your channel. Ask an administrator.
panel.title: Your voice channel
panel.description: Manage this channel with the buttons below. Only its owner (and moderators) can use them; anyone in the channel can claim it once its owner has left.
modal.rename.title: Rename the channel
modal.rename.label: New name
modal.limit.title: User limit
modal.limit.label: Maximum members (0 for no limit)
select.trust: Who can join even when the channel is locked or hidden?
select.invite: Who do you want to invite? They will be trusted and receive a DM.
select.block: Who can no longer see or join the channel?
select.kick: Who should be disconnected from the channel?
select.untrust: Whose access do you want to reset?
select.noMember: This member is no longer on the server.
action.notTemporary: This is not a temporary voice channel.
action.notOwner: Only the owner of the channel can do this.
access.full: The trusted and blocked lists cannot hold more than {{max}} members in total.
rename.pending: Discord is holding the rename back: the channel will be called **{{name}}** in a few minutes.
rename.invalid: The name must be 1 to 100 characters long.
rename.rateLimited: Discord only allows renaming a channel twice every 10 minutes: try again {{time}}.
limit.done: At most {{limit}} members can join the channel.
limit.removed: The channel no longer has a user limit.
limit.invalid: The limit must be a whole number from 0 to 99.
lock.done: The channel is locked: only trusted members can join it.
hide.done: The channel is hidden: only trusted members can see it.
trust.done: {{users}} can now join the channel, even when it is locked or hidden.
trust.none: Choose members other than the owner and the bots.
invite.done: {{user}} is trusted and was invited by DM.
invite.noDm: {{user}} is trusted, but could not be reached by DM.
invite.dm: {{user}} invites you to their voice channel on **{{guild}}**: {{channel}}
revoke.none: These members were neither trusted nor blocked.
revoke.empty: No member is trusted or blocked in this channel.
block.done: {{users}} can no longer see or join the channel.
block.none: Choose members other than yourself, the owner and the bots.
kick.empty: Nobody else is in the channel.
kick.none: None of these members is in the channel.
kick.failed: The bot could not disconnect these members.
claim.notInChannel: Join the channel to claim it.
claim.ownerPresent: {{owner}} is still in the channel: ask them to transfer it to you.
claim.ownsAnother: You already own another temporary channel.
transfer.empty: Nobody else is in the channel to receive it.
transfer.invalid: Choose another member than the owner, and not a bot.
transfer.notInChannel: {{user}} must be in the channel to receive it.
delete.failed: The bot could not delete the channel.
